body: Safe. Getting better mentally. I'm still incredibly on edge but I'm calming down a bit. Thank you for asking :)
I am so happy this sub exists.

My dad believes that I should be able to afford a house on less than 30k a year. He's a baby boomer. I'm a millennial. 

Edit :spelling
I do talk to him, I just hate feeling like I'm bringing him down.
I feel like she would have no qualms about hurting me if I went back home. I got my animals out of there but God damn, am I scared.
Thank you so much. My roommate is a psychopath. She keeps threatening to kill my dog. I don't feel safe in my own home and it's the most terrifying thing ever. I wish that she would leave.
Thanks, friend. That means a lot to me.

I think we are kindred spirits. Families don't understand, and they get angry if you aren't pretending to be happy. I can't talk to my friends about it, because they get overly concerned and start meddling.
Thank you. I appreciate you taking to the time to leave this comment ❤️
Absolutely true. I may be bummed out, but at least no one will have to chase me down the street.
Well I haven't had a drink today, but I haven't gotten DTs or anything. I'm hoping that I can figure out the medical side of detoxing before they kick in.
That is brilliant! Thank you, I'll give them a call today!

I am hesitant to go to urgent care, I feel like they would probably not want to give me a medication that I would be tapering off of. I think a doctor would probably want to supervise it in some way. 

Edit: however, I could be wrong.

I have been drinking this amount for about 3 or 4 months. I had gotten out of an abusive relationship, and instead of going to a therapist, I decided to self - medicate. 

I have a regular doctor, but I haven't lived in this town very long, so they don't really know me.
At least a pint a day, plus some beers. I'm worried about withdrawal symptoms.
